pr.title: Fix search saying No items yet. when nothing matches

lenses.note: Change matches the PR words: a no-match search shows the new message, and an empty table still shows 'No items yet.'. It is a small bug fix with no real design choice.
No spec file in the change.

Three new tests cover the no-match message, escaping of the search text, and the empty-table case. The first two fail against the old code. test/apply-migrations.js resets the DB before each test, so the DELETE in the third test can't leak into others. I did not run the tests; CI runs them.
No docs mention the empty-state message, so nothing is stale.
The count query only runs when the search finds nothing. Message selection is correct. Because of the `n > 0` check, an empty table with a search still says 'No items yet.'.
The search text is escaped before it goes into the message, and a test covers this. The SQL is parameterised.
The diff changes one text string in a server-rendered page and touches no UI files (no CSS, no components).
The diff changes one text string in a server-rendered page and touches no UI files, so there is no UI flow to exercise.
Title is under 72 characters. The body's claims match the diff.
